The accepted consumer and common-image-fault classifier retain their corresponding matcher/archive instances.
accepted_implementation.actual_pointer_proof: connect_once records code identities, instance checks and source paths before and after the unique route call; mismatches raise. These are future runtime checks, not claims of already observed execution.
